IncidentDef.label: cursed spirit manifestation
IncidentDef.letterText: Cursed spirits are coalescing out of the world's accumulated malice near your colony. {0} curses claw their way into reality and turn toward the living.\n\nExorcise them before they tear your people apart.

IncidentDef.label: disaster curse
IncidentDef.letterText: A Disaster Curse has manifested: {0}, a named special-grade cursed spirit, approaches with an escort of lesser curses.\n\nThis is no ordinary curse. It wields its innate cursed technique, and if your sorcerers close in it may expand its domain. Exorcise it, and its technique will remain behind as a remnant a colonist can absorb.
